variants.description: Verify tests pass, then present the integration options for a finished branch (merge locally, push and open a pull request, or keep it as-is), execute the choice, and clean up the worktree safely. This is the internal integration stage of the delivery-flow workflow. Use it only after implementation is verified, when the user asks to integrate the work or asks what their integration options are, for example "finish this branch", "merge my work", "open a PR", or "what are my options for getting this merged?". Never activate it directly for an unrelated standalone request.

variants.hypothesis: Leading with what the user wants, in the user's words, matches requests better than leading with what the skill does.

variants.hypothesis: A short description is easier to match than a long, conditional one.
